items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: Oh yeah, he ran his show and his brother, sure. I remember him.

ctx.x: Yes, can't take it, that's all. And all good people, it's just a pity, you know what I mean? Just a pity.

Kid René's brother is still playing, but he's in the church. No, I think it's Jehovah's Witnesses I believe. Is that right? And he has his band there, Joe René. Do you remember him? He used to play with her.
Oh yeah, he ran his show and his brother, sure. I remember him.
